description: This source file implements a Raspberry Pi display and surface management system with input handling, including virtual input callbacks, surface creation/destruction, and display configuration, within a Thunder framework environment.

classes.name: Platform
classes.description: Abstracts display and cursor management for Raspberry Pi, with different implementations for VC6 and non-VC6 environments.

classes.name: Display
classes.description: Represents a display device, manages surfaces, input, and communication with the Thunder framework, including creation, destruction, and input event processing.

classes.name: SurfaceImplementation
classes.description: Implements a surface within the display, managing native EGL surfaces, geometry, opacity, and Z-order.

classes.name: RemoteAccess
classes.description: Provides remote interface for a surface, exposing properties like surface handle, size, name, opacity, and Z-order.

methods.name: Display::Process
methods.description: Processes input messages from the pipe, dispatching input events to surfaces.

methods.name: Display::Create
methods.description: Creates a new surface with specified name, width, height, and callback.

methods.name: Display::OfferClientInterface
methods.description: Offers a client interface to the compositor server.

methods.name: Display::RevokeClientInterface
methods.description: Revokes a client interface from the compositor server.

methods.name: SurfaceImplementation::RemoteAccess::Opacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity of the surface.

methods.name: SurfaceImplementation::RemoteAccess::Geometry
methods.description: Sets the geometry of the surface.

methods.name: SurfaceImplementation::RemoteAccess::ZOrder
methods.description: Sets the Z-order of the surface.
